### X2_Save

    X2_Save(slot:int, info:string, sector:string, age:int)
    X2_Save(slot:int, info:string, sector:string, age:int, extra:int)

returns int (1 = request queued, 0 = refused); answers at once; in AP+FL; number AP 3, FL 3; handler `0x00406e28` (AP), `0x0047b5a6` (FL); confidence high.

**Queues a savegame into a slot; the save itself happens at the end of the frame in the main loop.**

If MainState.startMode == 1 (the script-session/intro start mode) returns 0 and does nothing. Otherwise sets MainState.requestFlags \|= 4 (save requested), saveSlot = arg1 raw dword, saveArgC = arg4 raw dword (the age/time value written to the header), saveArgA = heap copy of arg2 (header info text), saveArgB = heap copy of arg3 (header sector text), saveArgD = arg5 raw dword if argc >= 5 else 0 (stored, not used by the save routine), and returns 1. Nothing is written during the call: Main::SessionLoop later calls the main script object's BeforeSave, Save routine (slot, info, sector, age), frees both copies, then calls SaveFinished2(result) on the main object, or SaveFinished(result) when it has no SaveFinished2. A second X2_Save in the same frame overwrites the request (the first two copies leak). The header strings are what X2_LoadSaveNames returns as elements 0 and 1. Sync (every X2 case resumes the task before the dispatcher returns; Script::X2CommandDispatcher AP 0x00406de0, FL 0x0047b560).

- **FL:** same
- **x3_src:** differs: B162 (non-string info/sector saves as the empty string instead of strlen(NULL) crash)
- **Bug:** AP 0x00406e5e/0x00406e95, FL 0x0047b5a6: info/sector are passed to strlen/strcpy without a type check; a non-string arg crashes the game (NULL deref). Fixed in x3_src (B162). A repeated call before the frame ends leaks the previous copies (AP; x3_src same, minor).

### X2_LoadSaveNames

    X2_LoadSaveNames()

returns array[13] or int 0; answers at once; in AP+FL; number AP 4, FL 4; handler `0x00406efe` (AP), `0x0047b67c` (FL); confidence high.

**Returns the header of every save slot as a 13-element array for the load/save menus.**

Save::ReadSaveSlotHeaders (AP 0x00405280, FL 0x00479a30): allocates a 13-element array; element i is slot i+1 (file name from the path table format at pathTable+0x30 with the number i+1). Element i = int 0 if the file does not open (gzip or plain), lacks the XSA3 tag, or a header string is too long (info >= 1000, sector >= 1000, third string >= 100 bytes; lengths are big-endian dwords). Otherwise a 5-element array {info:string, sector:string, int A, int B, mtime:int} where A is the second and B the first big-endian dword after the third string (x3_src names them age and story build), mtime = File::GetModifiedTime of the save file (seconds). The third header string is read and discarded. If the result is an array the task gets it (ownership passes to the script), otherwise int 0. Sync (every X2 case resumes the task before the dispatcher returns; Script::X2CommandDispatcher AP 0x00406de0, FL 0x0047b560).

- **FL:** same
- **x3_src:** differs: each slot array has a 6th element (1 when the save is loadable by this build, kc/README.md "Saves"; not in bugs.md); slot path strings no longer leak
- **Bug:** AP 0x00405280: the formatted path of each slot is overwritten every iteration and only the last one is freed (12 small strings leak per call; script sees nothing). x3_src uses an owned string.

### X2_XMLImportGalaxy

    X2_XMLImportGalaxy(file:string, mode:int)

returns array/any or int 0; answers at once; in AP+FL; number AP 8, FL 8; handler `0x00406fc3` (AP), `0x0047b733` (FL); confidence medium.

**Loads a galaxy/map XML file and converts its element tree into nested script arrays.**

Script::LoadPckXml(arg1, "X2_XMLImportGalaxy") (file looked up in the game catalogue, .pck/.xml); NULL doc -> int 0. Otherwise result starts as int 0 and for every element node among the document root and its siblings Script::XmlGalaxyNodeToArray(result, node, mode=arg2 raw) rebuilds the result (the last top-level element wins). The converter maps map-file elements (universe, sectors \<o t=..>, stations, ships, wares, expressions) to arrays {class, subtype, value/children..}; the universe element is expanded only when mode is 6 or 7 (AP), other modes give int 0 for it. The doc is freed; the result array belongs to the script. Exact array layout per element type is in Cell::xmlGalaxyNodeToArray (x3_src cell_script.cpp ~l.2100-2400), not re-derived here. Sync (every X2 case resumes the task before the dispatcher returns; Script::X2CommandDispatcher AP 0x00406de0, FL 0x0047b560).

- **FL:** differs: the universe element is expanded only for mode 7 (AP: 6 or 7) - x3_src writeGalaxyUniverse #if X3_FL
- **x3_src:** same

### X2_StopBenchmarkScene

    X2_StopBenchmarkScene()

returns int (always 0); answers at once; in AP+FL; number AP 18, FL 18; handler `0x00407245` (AP), `0x0047b977` (FL); confidence medium.

**Ends the running benchmark scene and records its average FPS.**

Only in benchmark mode (cmdFlags & 0x10). If a scene is active: avg = frames / (elapsed game ms as 16.16 / 1000), stored at g_BenchAvgFps[index\*3], then the three slots (avg/min/max) are written 0 again (sic: the average is overwritten immediately), benchmarkActive = 0, cmdFlags &= ~0x2000. If none is active: the three slots for the stored index are zeroed. Returns int 0. Sync (every X2 case resumes the task before the dispatcher returns; Script::X2CommandDispatcher AP 0x00406de0, FL 0x0047b560).

- **FL:** same
- **x3_src:** differs: B146 (index range-checked; stats kept in BenchmarkRuntime)
- **Bug:** AP 0x004072bc: the computed average is stored and then overwritten with 0 by the next store to the same slot, so the per-scene average never survives (verified in the listing: FSTP 0x004072bc then FLDZ; FST to the same slot 0x004072ce; FL same). Index not range-checked (B146).

### X2_GetControlMatrix

    X2_GetControlMatrix(control:int, secondSet:int, shiftTable:int)

returns int; answers at once; in AP+FL; number AP 28, FL 27; handler `0x0040744f` (AP), `0x0047bb87` (FL); confidence medium.

**Returns the axis binding assigned to a joystick/mouse control code.**

Input::GetAxisBinding(control, second, shift) (AP 0x004123e0): the control code maps to an axis slot (controlCodeToAxisSlot; unknown code -> 0). Mouse codes (>= the mouse base) read the mouse table (second set = slot+2); joystick codes read the joystick table, second set and shift(alternate) table selecting the quarter. Returns the binding id (AxisBinding enum, 0 = none). Sync (X2 dispatcher AP 0x00406de0 resumes the task in every case).

- **FL:** same
- **x3_src:** differs: tables extended for every button of several GameInput devices (commits 5ce2720e1, 5ae857146); stock codes answer as before (not re-verified); not in bugs.md

### X2_SetControlMatrix

    X2_SetControlMatrix(control:int, binding:int, secondSet:int, shiftTable:int)

returns int (always 0); answers at once; in AP+FL; number AP 29, FL 28; handler `0x00407471` (AP), `0x0047bbaf` (FL); confidence medium.

**Assigns an axis binding to a joystick/mouse control code.**

Input::SetAxisMapping(binding=arg2, control=arg1, second=arg3, shift=arg4) (AP 0x004123a0; note the swapped order of the first two args). Unknown control code: nothing. Joystick codes go to the joystick table (second/shift select the table); mouse codes write the mouse table (slot or slot+2) when the slot and binding are in range. Persisted with the controls config elsewhere, not here. Sync (X2 dispatcher AP 0x00406de0 resumes the task in every case).

- **FL:** same (FL passes the four args in a different register order to its own SetAxisMapping; mapping not re-verified)
- **x3_src:** differs: extended device/button tables (GameInput, commit 5ae857146); not in bugs.md

### X2_SaveStringToRegistry

    X2_SaveStringToRegistry(name:string, value:string)

returns int 1/0; answers at once; in AP+FL; number AP 34, FL 33; handler `0x00407588` (AP), `0x0047bcbc` (FL); confidence high.

**Writes a string value to the game's registry key.**

Script::RegistryWriteValue (AP 0x004b83f0): RegCreateKeyEx then RegSetValueEx REG_SZ (strlen+1 bytes). Returns 1 on success, 0 if the key cannot be created or the write fails. Registry: HKEY_CURRENT_USER\\Software\\EGOSOFT\\\<gameName>\\Values (gameName from the path table), value name = arg1 string; a non-string name -> NULL (read natives return 0; the write natives pass NULL = the key default value). Sync (X2 dispatcher AP 0x00406de0 resumes the task in every case).

- **FL:** same
- **x3_src:** differs: B162 (non-string value writes the empty string)
- **Bug:** AP 0x004b83f0: non-string value -> strlen(NULL) crash (fixed in x3_src, B162). On a failed RegSetValueEx the key handle is not closed (handle leak; x3_src reproduces).

### X2_ReadStringFromRegistry

    X2_ReadStringFromRegistry(name:string)

returns string or int 0; answers at once; in AP+FL; number AP 35, FL 34; handler `0x004075b5` (AP), `0x0047bced` (FL); confidence high.

**Reads a string value from the game's registry key.**

Script::RegistryReadValue (AP 0x004b85c0): reads up to 500 bytes; returns a copy if the value exists, is REG_SZ and longer than 1 byte (non-empty); else int 0 (missing key/value, other type, empty string). Registry: HKEY_CURRENT_USER\\Software\\EGOSOFT\\\<gameName>\\Values (gameName from the path table), value name = arg1 string; a non-string name -> NULL (read natives return 0; the write natives pass NULL = the key default value). Sync (X2 dispatcher AP 0x00406de0 resumes the task in every case).

- **FL:** same
- **x3_src:** same
- **Bug:** AP 0x004b85c0: when the query fails or the value is empty the opened key is not closed (handle leak per call; x3_src reproduces).

## Natives of the x3_src engine

Only in the x3_src engine (both editions); the original exes answer int 0 at once. Their entries are in spec_x3src.jsonl.

### X2_GetStoryBuild

    X2_GetStoryBuild()

returns int; answers at once; in x3_src only; number AP 61, FL 60; handler `x3_src src/script/x2_command_dispatcher.cpp x2GetStoryBuild`; confidence high.

**Returns the build number of the story object a new game loads (0 if not found).**

The build id of the story object a new game loads (x3story, or the -story command line object), read from its file; 0 when the file is not found. At once. x3_src engine only: in X3AP.exe the number 61 and in X3FL.exe 60 falls to the X2 dispatcher's default arm and answers int 0 (the original exes have no such name either). Used by the x3intro MainMenu version line.

- **FL:** absent from X3FL.exe; the x3_src engine adds it for both editions (FL number 60)
- **x3_src:** new native (kc/README.md)
- **Notes:** x3::script::SaveBuildBatch::build of g_startupResources.storyObject(Story). The main menu's version line (x3intro MainMenu). The number follows STA_LoadDIDSaveData, one lower in FL (FL has no X2_GetModName).
